raw:
Agent Name: WebSurfer
, Step Number: 17
, Reason for Mistake: WebSurfer prematurely concluded there were “technical issues” and pivoted to alternative sources instead of properly using the Wayback Machine (e.g., direct snapshot URLs like web.archive.org/web/20210322*/https://www.virtuerestaurant.com/menus and 20210421* or testing menu URL variants). This deviation from the required approach led to failure to retrieve and compare the archived menus and thus to miss the correct answer (shrimp).
